title: test(ui): the live member's API requests carry the member alone, not the inherited admin cookie
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi96VGP7vMPA9C54zyjz2LMch)_

Fixes #31827

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：夜间 live 层的成员夹具改为只用成员自己的凭据发 API 请求（成员自己的会话 cookie 加它的 Bearer），成员登录也从空状态开始；`read-only-member-record.spec.ts` 只换成调用新助手，断言一条未动。
- 为什么改：在 `@playwright/test` 里，不指定 `storageState` 新建的请求上下文会继承配置里的管理员 cookie，于是成员请求同时带着管理员 cookie 和成员 Bearer。#31469 起服务端拒绝这种「两个账号」的请求，数据路由回 401，夜间层因此变红。席位裁定：改夹具，不改产品。
- 风险与回滚：只动 `ui/e2e/live/` 下两个测试文件，不发布任何包，不动 `packages/`。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`ui/e2e/live/member.ts` 的 `memberRequestContext` 和模块注释里的 ⛔ 段。
- 两分钟验证：起后端后跑 `OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase exec vitest run test/console-live-specs.live.test.ts`，预期 `28 passed`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `ui/e2e/live/member.ts` gains `memberRequestContext(member)`: a request context carrying the member's own session cookie and its Bearer, with its `storageState` named so the config's administrator cookie is not inherited.
- The member's sign-in context starts from an empty `storageState` (`{ cookies: [], origins: [] }`) instead of the inherited administrator cookie, so the sign-in request names the member only.
- `read-only-member-record.spec.ts` builds its premise context with the helper. That is its only change: the `playwright` fixture it no longer uses leaves the destructuring, and no assertion moves.
- The module comment states the trap: inside `@playwright/test`, `playwright.request.newContext()` and the imported `request.newContext()` both start with the config's `use.storageState`.

No test was skipped, renamed or loosened. No change under `packages/`.

## Why

The nightly live tier went red at `6be71abc` on `read-only-member-record.spec.ts:48`, premise step: the member's `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_inquiry/<id>` answered 401 where 200 was expected.

Step 0 (seat ruling 6735238125):

- **Bisect.** Each commit measured on a fresh backend booted by `ui/e2e/live/ci/start-backend.sh`, with the spec's request shape:

  | Commit | Result |
  |:--|:--|
  | `44a030bf` (last green nightly) | green, read 200 / write 403 |
  | `133f75aec0~1` | green, 200 / 403 |
  | `133f75aec0` #31469 | **red**, 401 / 401 |
  | `ed4b83226b` #31443 | red |
  | `59630d9357` #31622 | red |
  | `8c9260f79c` #31657 | red |
  | `f127b04e07` #31686 | red |
  | `6be71abc` (red nightly) | red |

- **Cause.** The member's context was `playwright.request.newContext({ extraHTTPHeaders: { Authorization: 'Bearer <member>' } })`. Inside `@playwright/test` that context inherits the config's `use.storageState`, which is the global setup's administrator cookie. Measured: the context's cookie equals the administrator's. So each premise request carried two accounts' credentials. Before #31469 the bearer won. Since #31469 the session read refuses such a request with `CREDENTIALS_NAME_DIFFERENT_ACCOUNTS`, and the data route answers its own anonymous 401. #31469's acceptance notes describe exactly that data-route answer, so the product behaves as ruled and the fixture relied on what #31469 ruled out.

## Sweep (owed by the ruling)

Every live spec and helper under `ui/e2e/live/` that builds a request context or sends a credential:

| Site | Accounts it sends | Action |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `read-only-member-record.spec.ts` premise context | admin cookie (inherited) + member Bearer | **moved onto `memberRequestContext`** |
| `member.ts` sign-in context (`request.newContext()`) | admin cookie (inherited) on the member's sign-in | **moved onto an empty `storageState`** |
| `read-only-member-record.spec.ts` member browser context | member `storageState` named explicitly | one account, unchanged |
| `global-setup.ts` sign-in context | none (global setup runs before any `use` state exists) | one account, unchanged |
| `inline-edit-polish-2572.spec.ts` `request` + Bearer | admin cookie + admin token from the same `state.json` | one account, unchanged |
| `studio-customize-journey.spec.ts` `request` override | `storageState` passed by name (admin), no other credential | one account, unchanged |
| `studio-object-designer.spec.ts` in-page `fetch` | admin page's own cookie + its own localStorage token | one account, unchanged |
| every other spec's `request.get/post/…` (cascading-options, grid-file-upload, list-row-action-cel, master-detail, record-form-direct-url, record-history-display) | admin `request` fixture alone | one account, unchanged |

Measured for the two inherited sites: the imported `request.newContext()` and `playwright.request.newContext()` each start with 1 cookie under this config; with `storageState: { cookies: [], origins: [] }` they start with 0.

## Verification

All heavy runs went through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`. Head `86082eb9b5`, backend closure and `pnpm console:build` rebuilt at the head first.

- **Nightly live file, head:** `OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly pnpm exec vitest run test/console-live-specs.live.test.ts` in `examples/app-showcase`: Playwright `28 passed (1.3m)`, vitest `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 1 passed (1)`.
- **Ablation:** `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` deletes the helper's `storageState` line in `member.ts` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `d4e1a39d33f5` → `dc6c2ff0d686`), so the inherited administrator cookie is back. The same run: `✘ read-only-member-record.spec.ts:48`, `Expected: 200`, `Received: 401`, `Test Files 1 failed (1)`. Restored: blob equals HEAD's (`d4e1a39d33f5`), `git diff HEAD` empty, `git status --porcelain` empty.
- **Before the fix, on main `3487ccc1`:** the same nightly run was red, 1 of 28, the same 401.
- **Dispatch gates:** see the os-dev-report on #31827 for each command's exit code and the `--ran` reconciliation; `pnpm lint` and `eslint` over the two touched files are reported there too.

No changeset: the diff publishes nothing (`ui/e2e/live/` only), so this PR carries `skip-changeset`.
